scope: Generated model formal ownership, server persistence, exact-generation async recovery, original-source authoring recovery, and inspection-only presentation compatibility

validation.command: node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-isolation=none tests/source-authoring-cache.test.ts tests/source-authoring-session.test.ts tests/authoring-workspace-cache.test.ts tests/generated-canvas.test.ts tests/previewApp.test.ts tests/previewPanelDocument.test.ts tests/previewGeneralization.test.ts tests/previewInterop.test.ts tests/previewPresentation.test.ts tests/source-composition-editing.test.ts tests/editor-workflow-independent.test.ts

contracts: Generated document and retained presentation persist through /api/open and /api/documents before editor exit and URL change.
Formal source ownership remains bound when the preview contains additional inspection objects; preview source bytes still must match.
Only globally one-to-one node evidence projects formal geometry, styles, pinning, expansion, selection, and edge ownership.
Inspection objects retain preview alias, colors, expansion, focus, and evidence controls without semantic source authority.
Generated workspaces use IndexedDB with distinct exact document/source/IR keys; old localStorage records migrate only after validated reads.
Delayed cache recovery or failures cannot cross the current load generation; save failures keep current editor/history.
Authoring history, selection, camera, geometry and exact binding guards remain covered by real callback/backend regression tests.

Original-source authoring sessions restore from exact document/source/IR keys and complete architecture identity; reload preserves edits, undo/redo, draft identity, selection and camera instead of creating a fresh import.
Damaged or unreadable exact source-session records cannot silently replace unsaved edits; exact legacy migration and per-source coalesced writes retain independent model sessions.
Async editor hydration defers gestures and persistence until validated restore; explicit initial workspaces win and stale writers cannot cross remount or load identity.
limitations: Browser acceptance, final build, full suite and server legacy project binding are verified separately by the root agent.
Dynamic or unresolved source semantics retain their prior boundaries; visual inspection does not authorize tensor rewrites.
